# Taco John's New England

> Reliance Hospitality operates Taco John's restaurants in Massachusetts and Connecticut. Bold Mexican food, tacos, burritos, Potato Olés®, breakfast, and a Value Menu.

## Locations

- Leominster, MA: 536 N. Main Street, Leominster, MA 01453. Phone: (978) 252-0775. Hours: Mon–Thu 7:00 AM–midnight, Fri–Sat 7:00 AM–1:00 AM, Sun 7:00 AM–midnight.
- Boston, MA: 77 Summer Street, Boston, MA 02111. Phone: (617) 431-8787. Hours: Mon–Sat 7:00 AM–midnight, Sun 8:00 AM–midnight.
- Newington, CT: 56B Costello Road, Newington, CT 06111. Coming soon. Phone: (800) 854-0819.

## Offerings

- Mexican favorites: tacos, burritos, Stuffed Grilled Tacos, Fried Chicken Taco, Potato Olés®
- Breakfast burritos and Mexican Donut Bites
- Value Menu starting at $2
- Taco Tuesday
- Catering
- Online ordering: https://order.tacojohns.com/
- Bigger Bolder Rewards and the Taco John's mobile app
